newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Norilsk trade union deputy head wants arrears paid.
newsitem.headline: Norilsk trade union deputy head wants arrears paid.

text.p: A senior Norilsk Nickel trade union official told a news conference on Friday that workers at the flagship plant were upset about delays in the repayment of salary arrears.

Boris Degtyaryov, deputy head of the United Trade Union Committee of the plant, told an audience at the State Duma lower house of parliament that problems between labour and management had not been resolved.
"There are still big debts," he said, criticising the plant management for, he said, failing to pay off 1.3 trillion roubles in salary arrears. "There are still big overdue wages."
The committee's head said earlier by telephone from Norilsk that workers were not satisfied with the results of talks with management but that output and loadings had not been disrupted.

Pyotr Romanov, chairman of the Duma's commission for examining economic and social issues at industrial enterprises, told the same conference that the RAO Norilsky Nickel group, a major producer of non-ferrous and precious metals, could not survive without state support.
